integrity: Analytic renewal-saddle proof. Independent numerical quadrature passed 128 diagnostics; tests are not a proof. Novelty comparison acknowledges pre-existing univariate and driftless-multivariate results. No independent scientific audit.
limitations: Equal GBM drift and volatility, independent Brownian innovations and fully synchronized Poisson resets; fixed finite population before the high-threshold limit; no growing-population uniformity, correlated-noise or partial-batch extension.
title: A drift-controlled hierarchy of collective extremes under shared geometric-Brownian resetting
